title: Entry acknowledgement command v1 / Entry 确认命令 v1
description: Defines one bounded canonical acknowledgement command for a neutral entry. / 为中性 entry 定义一个受限的规范化确认命令。

contractVersion.description: Canonical command contract version. / 规范化命令契约版本。

kind.description: Only command kind accepted by this first transaction. / 此首个事务唯一接受的命令 kind。

commandId.description: Caller-owned stable idempotency identifier; it is neither a user identifier nor a server token. / 调用方自有的稳定幂等标识；它不是用户标识或服务端 token。

entryId.description: Stable neutral entry identifier selected from a canonical result. / 从规范化结果中选择的稳定中性 entry 标识。
